original_checklist_requirements.requirement: Preserve and assign disposition to the five modified tracked files and 175 untracked entries. Keep approval/customer/generated material private; do not blanket-add, reset, clean or discard it. Produce a reviewable source-only candidate and preservation evidence.

Refresh one authoritative status and task register. `CURRENT_STATE.md`, `MASTER_PLAN.yaml`, the untracked Hermes state and `EXECUTION_STATE.json` describe different historical revisions. Carry verified fixes forward without promoting their old acceptance claims.
**R01:** finish observed component inventory, named file ownership and timestamped baseline evidence. Map old P0–P38 phases to actual code and corrected task IDs; avoid duplicate implementations.

Close the stale integration proposal by recording actual ancestry and integrated revision. `e68873c5`, `c50fc975`, `191d8585`, `0fe5047b` and `923c14e5` are already ancestors of HEAD. Do not repeat their cherry-picks or fast-forward proposal.

Compare the separate `a365d6b1` reliability candidate with current source. It is not an ancestor of HEAD. The router-only adoption does not establish adoption of the other candidate paths; selectively retain needed fixes after review.

Review the 33 newer local commits and obtain exact-head hosted CI, security/dependency checks, package/import verification and Sonar results before release. Publish only the selected reviewed changes under the applicable authorization.

Complete human/code review of PR #52 and resolve current relevant findings. Refresh older primary/secondary Sonar inventories rather than assuming their historic counts remain current. Decide PR readiness and master integration separately.

**S10:** finish historical credential exposure review and reconcile scan coverage. One register records 87 assessed inputs with 16 held; another later execution records an incomplete scan with 15 candidates. Reconcile scope and fingerprints before claiming clearance. Determine ownership, restrictions, purpose and active exposure without exposing values.

**S20:** obtain a specific rotation decision for genuinely affected credentials, execute authorized rotation if needed and verify remediation. Signed no-rotation-required evidence can close this task if warranted; do not rotate every scanner match automatically.
**S30:** finish or verify preventative secret scanning, prompt-injection boundaries, permission controls and CI regression coverage across actual worker entry points.

**C10:** establish account-level FCC/Nous/Hermes/Claude entitlement, billing, supported model and reset/quota evidence. Reconcile historical charges. Health or an empty local ledger does not establish a free route.

**C20:** complete shared atomic admission before requests across the MoneyMachine router, global Hermes, direct FCC bridge, CLI and fallback paths. Cover concurrent reservations, reconciliation and unknown-cost rejection. The existing router response-cost latch is only part of this requirement.
**C30:** prove 429, exhausted/unknown quota, concurrent admissions, provider error, failover and cost-stop behavior. Do not enable external routes until route-specific evidence permits them.

**A10:** finish independent live scheduler/process identity and continuous source/configuration drift observation. Bind actual executable, loaded revision, interpreter, configuration and DB identity. Current opt-in startup manifest and caller-provided scheduler label do not complete this.

Verify direct worker entry points share ownership, locking and idempotency with scheduled paths. Finish staging progress/cursor preservation across snapshots and restarts, bounded backups, and live-path contract-test isolation.
**E10:** independently test global, database-write, outbound, AI and scheduler stops, including persistence across restarts and failover. Retain explicit default-deny behavior.

**E20:** finish durable outbox acceptance, exact content/recipient binding, stale approval refusal, uncertain-acknowledgement reconciliation, suppression, cooldown and stop-on-response. Use fake transports; never blindly retry an unknown delivery.

**B10:** demonstrate one existing review-only NZ lead pipeline on isolated staging data: identity → evidence-backed audit → qualified opportunity → remediation/demo → authentic before/after proof → deterministic quote → QA-reviewed draft packet. No sending.
**B20:** validate freshness, provenance, identity deduplication, branch/parent distinctions and evidence hashes. Refresh promising existing leads before increasing discovery volume.
Complete genuine independent contact labels and prospect-disjoint intelligence holdout acceptance. Preserve unknown/held states; machine corrections do not replace independent ground truth.

**B30:** establish realistic offers and delivery effort from measured work, with an explicit finite positive operator rate. Separate technical severity from commercial value; validate claimed demand and outcome improvements.

Obtain exact-head real browser/PDF/image/Lighthouse/Lychee evidence where required. Resolve or explicitly restrict the three canonical skips; global accounting and independent provider receipt skips require separate acceptance, not cosmetic test changes.
Confirm recurring Obsidian/report destination, period semantics, collision handling, retention and source-backed reporting. A manually exported dashboard does not prove recurring operation.
**O10:** profile Mac CPU, memory, disk, concurrency, queue throughput and actual job completion. Use measured constraints to tune existing workers.

**O20:** establish actual commercial feedback, false-positive/calibration metrics and reviewed improvement experiments. Require measured benefit before promotion; keep autonomous production modification disabled.

**G10:** finish the non-bypassable aggregate release gate and immutable manifest binding accepted source, configuration, security, entitlement, tests, restore and send-off evidence. Independent signoff remains required.

**G20:** run a staging canary and dry-run rollback with outbound off. Test crash/restart/lease recovery, duplicate prevention, DB integrity, preservation of new writes/outbox/suppression, and recovery timing. Existing D10 isolated restore success is useful but does not complete live/staged rollback acceptance.

**G30:** reconcile duration/config-consumer requirements and prepare separately authorized 24-hour and 72-hour staging soaks. Diagnose earlier network/sample failures. Require one owner, frozen loaded revision/config, complete duration and sample coverage, resource/heartbeat/DB/FK/queue/DLQ/accounting checks and independently recalculated final acceptance. No historical uptime credit.

**G40:** prepare and obtain approval for a pinned, review-only production canary; verify actual runtime and approved worker subset. The supported launchd job is currently absent; starting it is a separate operational action, not an audit repair.

**G50 — optional:** only if live outreach is wanted, complete sender/transport authentication and release evidence, eligibility review, exact recipient/message approvals, opt-out/suppression, caps and canary reconciliation. Production approval never authorizes outreach by itself.

Fix `money-machine/supervisor/logquery.py`: `--since` parses `delta` but subtracts zero days; aware log timestamps are compared with a naive cutoff. Test actual requested time windows and timezone behavior. Verify newest-first limiting across multiple files rather than returning early from the first scanned files.
Optional competitor-research worker: runner explicitly reports unimplemented. Implement only if required, otherwise keep it disabled and truthfully unavailable.

Optional AI prototype generation: adapter currently returns placeholder patch content when enabled. Implement and evaluate real generation or explicitly reject unsupported use; do not represent a placeholder as usable proof.
Optional BrowserGym and Inspect AI evaluation adapters are explicit stubs. Implement only for a selected evaluation requirement.
`wa secret list` intentionally reports unsupported behavior without Keychain access. Keep this documented, or define and review a real secret-management requirement before implementing it.
Data foundation: normalized enrichment/source tables, ingestion runs/manifests, licensing, checksums, freshness/expiry, contradiction preservation, reversible migrations and DuckDB/Parquet staging.
Authoritative NZ spine: Companies Office bulk and NZBN enrichment, independent legal/trading names, entity status and dated authoritative observations, idempotent incremental refresh.
Discovery expansion: Overture NZ places and permitted OSM inputs, stable source IDs and confidence, existing dedupe/pipeline admission and branch distinctions.
Entity Resolution V2: Public Suffix List domains, business/domain/NZBN edges, LINZ address normalization, phone evidence, conflicts, confidence and human review thresholds.
Web intelligence: CrUX/History field data, canonical RDAP, Common Crawl lookup, timestamped snapshots and technology/material-change history; keep missing data unknown.
Market intelligence: versioned Stats NZ industry/region benchmarks and replayable market context; keep technical audit severity separate.

Security and learning data: confirmed-version OSV/CISA KEV enrichment, confidence, independently labeled identity/audit/opportunity gold sets and measured precision/recall. The roadmap proposes 100 identity records, 50 audited sites and 100 opportunity labels; these are targets, not observed completed datasets.
